key_findings: Systematic review of 20 preclinical kratom studies: mitragynine engages opioid/adrenergic/serotonergic receptors, reduces TRPV1 and inflammatory mediators.
Withdrawal after chronic MG linked to reduced histone acetylation, increased HDAC2, and Rab35 upregulation.
